_about: Build 2026-11-22a (test 58's fixes and every wish the tester made in one build, the user's pick "Everything", art build C, on top of 2026-11-21a: no crash at a getting on right after a change at the field kit, the parked bike's look put on only by loading its 3D again; the Wear (and Paint condition) on the worn bike through the look's swap at runtime and on the parked bike through the shells' blending meshes (the parked bike's runtime swap an A/B, [Look] OverlayParked, off); the game's aim blocked for real (its handler's struct name, [Steer] AimStruct), the third-person look as the plugin's own orbit; the field kit's bike held as the menu's renderer draws it, the wheel both ways and scrolling the lists over the list panel; other mods' attachments (a holster mod's copy of the pistol) following the rider's body; the up-shifts at their bands in every pull, the speed kept through a menu; the parked bike on the ground under both tyres, never rolled onto what stands beside it, leaning on its own side stand (an unfitted park too); the Paint condition slot under the Wear, the Wear on the exhaust, the engine's covers and the fork's lowers and over the badges, the overlays blending in the meshes, the muddy tread clean where it meets the road, three gears on metallic blue behind the 3D Brotherhood helmet, Nuka-Cola's script, six more headlamp colours, the front fender badge retired), packaged on 2026-11-10a's package as the asset base with thirteen overlays laid over it in this order (OVERLAY=<1>:<2>:...:<13>, the later winning): 2026-11-21a's nine, unchanged (/opt/cmb/assets15b/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/a/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/b/Data, /opt/cmb/assets16a/c/Data, /opt/cmb/assets17a/badges/Data, /opt/cmb/assets17a/plates/Data, /opt/cmb/assets21a/shells/Data, /opt/cmb/assets21a/wear/Data, /opt/cmb/assets21a/art2d/Data), then the shells unit's (/opt/cmb/assets22a/shells/Data: the five nifs by look_shells.py step B, static_paintwear, fork_paintwear, static_exhaust_wear, static_engine_wear and fork_black_wear appended, static_wear rebuilt over the badges, every overlay shell's alpha property blending, and the shells' 14 own materials, the 10 new and 2026-11-21a's static_wear and fork_wear four now blending; fork_badgeFront's two as they were), the wear unit's (/opt/cmb/assets22a/wear/Data, 243 files by look_wear.py: Paint condition's 30 textures and 20 materials and the Wear on the parts' 63 textures and 42 materials, new; the Wear's 28 materials (--overlay-depth), 18 of its static maps (--badge-grime) and the six muddy tyre diffuses (--tyre-mud) changed; 36 files as 2026-11-21a's), the art2d unit's (/opt/cmb/assets22a/art2d/Data: badges_d/_n/_s.dds by bike_art.py --badges and look_badges.py, replacing 2026-11-21a's; the six new lens colours' 12 materials and four textures by look_lamp.py) and the parked unit's (/opt/cmb/assets22a/parked/Data: CMB_BikeParked.nif by look_stand.py on the shells unit's parked nif 3dba1292..., its side stand down, f91d7abd...; it replaces the shells unit's). Only the parked overlay overlaps another of this build's (its one nif), and each overlay's SHA256SUMS matches its files. Keys starting with _ are comments. What differs from the 2026-11-21a package, in two kinds: (1) the commit's own shipped files, checked against the commit by the tracked-files check and never listed in vs_previous (verify_zips.py --list-changes compares only the assets and the compiled scripts): Data/CommonwealthMotorbike.esp, Data/MCM/Config/CommonwealthMotorbike/config.json, Data/F4SE/Plugins/CMB_Slope.ini, Data/Scripts/Source/User/CMB_ControllerScript.psc, CMB_LookF4SE.psc and CMB_BikeActivatorScript.psc, and Data/F4SE/Plugins/CMB_Slope.dll once the build's DLL is committed (the package takes the DLL from the commit, so tools/f4se-slope/build.sh's DLL has to be committed first; git diff --stat fbe9a7c <the build's commit> -- Data lists them); keybinds.json is 2026-11-21a's; (2) the compiled scripts and assets, below (vs_previous): 64 files changed, 181 added and three compiled scripts.
_previous: The 2026-11-21a package: the verifier's --previous (/opt/cmb/out/2026-11-21a/CommonwealthMotorbike_2026-11-21a). The asset base is 2026-11-10a's Data (assets.sha256), with 2026-11-21a's nine overlays and this build's four.

esp._records: espcmp.py 2026-11-21a's ESP (fbe9a7c) against this one: 'TES4: HEDR records 1285 -> 1337, next ID 0xCE7 -> 0xD1B', 'added 52 (000CE7-000D1A): 12 COBJ, 12 LIGH, 12 MSWP, 12 OMOD, 2 FLST, 1 GLOB, 1 KYWD', 'removed 0', 'changed 39' (3 ARMO: CMB_ap_PaintWear on both riding armours, the look item's attach points and template, the front fender's off it; the controller quest's VMAD; 6 FLST: CMB_LookCategories and CMB_LookSwapLists 15 -> 16 lists, the Headlamp's option and swap lists and the two light lists 5 -> 11; 1 COBJ: selective yellow's priority in the alphabetical order; 8 MSWP: the Wear's swaps 4 -> 10 entries, the part shells; 20 MSWP: the front fender's badge swaps, their targets now their sources). No new group (1307 records in 29 groups). The generator's --look-build 2026-11-21a writes 2026-11-21a's ESP, config.json and keybinds.json byte for byte (none of C5). The plugin's new behaviours need no form: the look's three new switches are bits of the existing CMB_LookOptions (262144, 524288, 1048576) and the parked bike's fit a bit of CMB_RoomOptions (32768) with ask kind 6 of CMB_RoomAskKind.
esp._edids: This build's 52 new forms first, in their IDs' order (0xCE7-0xD1A, the look's C5 block: Paint condition's global and attach point; the Headlamp's options 5-10 (halogen, daylight, iceblue, red, green, purple) and Paint condition's 0-5 (pristine, scratched, chipped, faded, worn, primer), each an MSWP, an OMOD and a COBJ; Paint condition's option and swap lists; per new headlamp colour a plain and a shadow-casting light), then 2026-11-21a's list, as it was (its 151 new forms, then 2026-11-17a's list).

_vs_previous: What verify_zips.py --list-changes compares: the assets (the files under Data/Meshes/CMB, Textures/CMB, Materials/CMB, Sound/FX/CMB and the riding clips' folder) and the compiled scripts (Data/Scripts/*.pex, by their code, not their headers) against the 2026-11-21a package. 64 files differ, each with its sha256 in this package (the overlays' SHA256SUMS; computed from the overlays against the 2026-11-21a package's folder): the five nifs (look_shells.py, the parked one then look_stand.py; 2026-11-21a's CMB_BikeParked 76013b2295..., CMB_BikeView 8a50f0a4c8..., CMB_BikeWorn bc5a512dca..., CMB_BikeWornRider 84408b7244..., CMB_BikeWornRiderF f01fc11b88...), the two wear shells' four own files (static_wear, fork_wear and their _worn twins, blending at alpha 0; 2026-11-21a's 07914e9bf3...), the Wear's 28 materials (wear_<look>_static and _fork and their _worn twins: depth written, alpha-tested at 8), 18 of the Wear's static maps (the grime over the badges: Bloody's _d and _s, Dusty's _d and _n, Muddy's _d and _s, and the three of Raider, Rusty, Wasteland and Weathered; the fork maps and the other three static maps are 2026-11-21a's), the six muddy tyre diffuses (the tread's faces clean; their 12 materials are 2026-11-21a's) and the badge atlas (badges_d/_n/_s.dds, the same sizes: the Brotherhood helmet's gears on metallic blue, Nuka-Cola's script; 2026-11-21a's dd4778e23b..., e9a4c7338c..., 3066229127...). 181 files are new, each with its sha256 as its unit's tool wrote it (two runs give the same): 84 materials (Paint condition's 20, the Wear on the parts' 42, the five new shells' own ten, the six lamp colours' 12) and 97 DDS (Paint condition's 30, the Wear on the parts' 63, the tinted lenses of Ice blue, Red, Green and Purple). Every sound and clip is 2026-11-21a's, and so are the other textures and materials. Three compiled scripts differ, their sources having changed: CMB_ControllerScript (the parked bike's look at its 3D's loads and at the mount, the runtime overlays and their refusals, the parked bike's fit and lean, slot 15), CMB_LookF4SE (ApplyParked's hold, ApplyParkedLoaded and ApplyWornOverlay asked again after their compose, Compose's own count, slot 15) and CMB_BikeActivatorScript (OnLoad), null accepting their bytes (their headers carry the packaged commit's time); the other nine keep their code under a new header. The commit's own files that change (CMB_Slope.dll and CMB_Slope.ini, the ESP, the MCM's config.json, the three .psc: _about) are not in this block.
